card.name: Step, group, class after a number
card.fires_on: Nouns like step, steps, group, class or spaced that follow a number or ordinal and name a unit of division or increment, often after a hyphen. Seen in dosing text and general web text.

modes.label: Hyphenated count compounds
modes.description: A hyphen plus group, step or class right after a number or ordinal.
modes.example: also does away with the 16<<-group>> limit from Panther and earlier versions of Mac

modes.label: Dose steps and spacing
modes.description: Words describing how doses are divided, increased or spaced.
modes.example: the usual dose is 250 mg qid in equally<< spaced>> doses

modes.label: General step or class
modes.description: Step or class after one, first or a fraction in non-medical text.
modes.example: are moving one<< step>> closer to achieving that goal with their work
